commands.name: SetTaskPlan
input: current_plan_revision where 0 means no current plan
steps: pure-preflight require canonical task_id UUIDv4 text, positive integer task_revision, nonnegative integer current_plan_revision, complete positive-duration accepted schedule, and when present a bounded one-line nonempty reason_category (1..128 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL/CR/LF); convert local schedule via OBJECTIVE_TIMEZONE_V1 before writer lock

inside UoW load exact Task and task_plan_current plus referenced immutable plan; missing Task returns TASK_NOT_FOUND, task revision mismatch returns TASK_STALE, current_plan_revision=0 requires exact absence of task_plan_current, positive current_plan_revision requires an exact current row with that revision, and any current row whose plan_revision_id does not resolve to the same Task fails closed as TASK_STALE

after exact Task/current-plan freshness is proven, if the requested UTC interval and scheduling_timezone_iana exactly equal the current immutable plan return semantic NO_CHANGE with no receipt child, plan row, Task revision or audit event

derive the effective ordinary plan lock from current writer authority: explicit_plan_lock=true; accepted non-correction Task execution/termination history; current WFM provider lifecycle Complete/Plan Cancel unless the exact current source_projection_revision has no pending review and has a resolved retain_local_work decision; or current Objective membership whose Objective is superseded, historical_provider_complete/historical_structure, or reviewed; any pending review bound to the exact current WFM source_projection_revision dominates every same-revision retain_local_work decision regardless of timestamp/UUID ordering and keeps ordinary planning locked; any such lock returns TASK_PLAN_LOCKED before receipt/domain mutation

append one immutable task_plan_revision with origin=manual, source_observation_id=null, predecessor_plan_revision_id equal to the prior current plan revision id or null when scheduling an unscheduled Task, and the optional reason_category; insert task_plan_current at revision 1 when previously absent or advance its revision exactly once when present; increment tasks.revision exactly once

if Task currently belongs to an Objective, preserve objective_task_membership_current.accepted_plan_revision_id and objective_envelope_projection unchanged; rebuild only the derived aggregate attention needed to surface plan_membership_mismatch, preserving any higher-priority existing safety attention reason
audit one task.plan_changed.v1 event with exact prior/new plan refs and resulting Task revision, commit, then request grouping recompute
rules: the public/browser SetTaskPlan command is manual operational-plan authority only: origin is fixed to manual and source_observation_id is always null; callers cannot select objective_initialization, wfm_source_adoption, retry_clone, correction or historical_source_structure provenance

objective_initialization is owned by the Objective creation flow, wfm_source_adoption by the reviewed LLD-04 WfmImportMutationService handoff, retry_clone by CreateLocalTaskRetry, correction by CorrectTaskPlan, and historical_source_structure by historical Objective acceptance
current_plan_revision is a freshness token: 0 means the current-plan row is exactly absent and any later plan creation is stale; a positive value must exact-match task_plan_current.revision

for current WFM provider Complete/Plan Cancel evidence, ordinary planning is unlocked by retain_local_work only when no pending source-terminal review exists for the exact same current source_projection_revision; a same-revision pending review always wins over any retain decision, including rows with equal created_at_utc values, so UUID ordering is never used as chronology

Task may exist unscheduled when task_plan_current is absent, but Beta 1.0 defines no destructive plan-clear operation; SetTaskPlan only schedules an unscheduled Task or replaces an unlocked current operational plan with another complete interval
accepted current Task plan and Objective membership-plan pin may temporarily differ without changing the accepted Objective envelope; the mismatch is review/regroup input, never silent regrouping
material plan acceptance advances tasks.revision and task_plan_current.revision exactly once; semantic NO_CHANGE advances neither
